# Touché Hairdressing

> Independent hair salon in Caterham, Surrey. Established 1985. Cutting, colour, smoothing, treatments and extensions in a luxury, editorial-style space at 11 Station Avenue.

Touché Hairdressing is a long-established independent salon serving Caterham and the wider Surrey area. The team specialises in precision cutting, bespoke colour (balayage, highlights, tonal correction), keratin smoothing systems, bond-building and botanical treatments, and quality hair extensions.

- Address: 11 Station Avenue, Caterham, Surrey, CR3 6LB, United Kingdom
- Phone: 01883 340771
- Booking: https://s-iq.co/BookingPortal/dist/?salonid=5d4b7112-81b5-464b-9ccf-8835ad6793a3&tab=contact
- Founded: 1985

## Featured products & treatments

- [Oligo Professionnel](https://www.touchehaircaterham.com/news/oligo-professionnel.html): Botanically-rich professional colour and care system used in-salon.
- [Organethic Pure Care](https://www.touchehaircaterham.com/news/organethic-pure-care.html): Ethical, sustainable luxury hair care range, available as standalone treatment from £20.
- [The Crown Professional](https://www.touchehaircaterham.com/news/the-crown-professional.html): Advanced keratin smoothing system, results last up to six months, treatments from £200.
